facts.fact: Burundi Eco reports the pilot phase of making biometric ID cards was launched in eleven communes including Gitega, Ngozi and Kayanza, and the Interior Minister told the National Assembly on 18 February 2025 the card should be available before the 2027 elections, after the family code is revised.
